definitions: An acronym for 'Bulk Molding Compound,' a type of thermosetting plastic material.
An acronym for 'British Motor Corporation,' a historic British automobile manufacturer.
An acronym for 'Baylor Medical Center,' a common name for various medical institutions.
examples: The new car model was produced by BMC.
We use BMC for the housing of electronic components.
She was admitted to BMC last night.
